style: OPDA editorial watercolour, as documented in DESIGN.md and /design-system
purpose: Human-facing orientation only. These illustrations do not encode normative ontology relationships.
reproductionBrief: Extra-wide landscape editorial pen-and-ink, watercolour and gouache illustration. Organic contours, tactile pigment and purposeful negative space. Off-white paper #F9F9F9, deep-purple ink #231F2F, substantial OPDA yellow #FEC92B, teal #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4 and supporting coral. No logo, embedded text, personal data, photography, 3D, glow or generic clipart. Retain complete recognisable subjects.

subjects.property-story: A British residential building with two dwelling entrances, a cutaway showing distinct internal spaces, and separate inspection reports and a floor plan. A warm, concrete introduction to distinguishing a building, dwellings, an inspection and its reports.
subjects.modelling-workbench: An overhead, shallow arrangement of practitioners' hands examining miniature building and dwelling studies, grouping coloured vocabulary cards and comparing separate reports, with a pencil and magnifying lens. No diagram arrows or labels.

darkModeEdit: Use the approved light image as the edit target. Preserve exact subjects, arrangement, relative sizes, perspective, crop and 3:1 geometry. Change paper to deep petrol-purple #231F2F, linework to pale ink and pigment to rich teal, violet, coral and OPDA yellow. This is not a night scene: no new objects, dramatic lighting, glow or text.
